questions.q: Why did the uncle punch the Doctor when he was first woken up?
choices: He thought it was Ben Ali coming back in the dark
He was dreaming that he was fighting a big shark
He was angry at being woken from a good sleep
He thought the Doctor had come to steal his snuff
questions.evidence: the man thought it was Ben Ali coming back

questions.q: Why had the Barbary Dragon left the uncle on the rock?
choices: He had tried to steal the pirates' gold
He had helped his nephew run away
He had made a hole in the pirate ship
He wouldn't promise to become a pirate
questions.evidence: when he wouldn't promise to become a pirate

questions.q: What had the uncle lived on for four days?
choices: Sea-weed
Rain-water
Snuff
Raw fish

questions.q: Why did sailors far out at sea think a terrible storm was coming?
choices: They saw dark clouds gather over the rock
They heard the swallows whistling so loudly
They felt the waves grow big and rough
They heard Jip barking from the far ship
questions.evidence: The noise they made was so great

questions.q: How did Jip act when Dab-Dab told him he was clever?
choices: He tossed his head and said it was nothing special
He barked and danced about the deck with joy
He said that the eagles had helped him a great deal
He hid inside the ship because he felt so shy

questions.q: How long had the boy's mother been sitting on a hill watching the sea?
choices: Two days
Four days
Forty days
Twenty days
questions.evidence: She had been sitting on a hill for twenty days

questions.q: The Mayor gave the Doctor "this little token from the grateful people." What is a "token" here?
choices: A coin used to pay for a ride
A letter asking him to stay
A small gift to show thanks
A ticket to the village party
questions.evidence: this little token from the grateful people of our worthy Town

questions.q: What was written on the gold collar the Mayor gave Jip?
choices: JIP-THE BRAVEST DOG OF THE SEVEN SEAS
JIP-THE CLEVEREST DOG IN THE WORLD
JIP-FINDER OF THE RED-HAIRED FISHERMAN
JIP-THE DOCTOR'S FAITHFUL FRIEND
questions.evidence: JIP-THE CLEVEREST DOG IN THE WORLD
